newsitem.title: USA: NIMO boosts power at 1,137 MW N.Y. plant.
newsitem.headline: NIMO boosts power at 1,137 MW N.Y. plant.

text.p: Niagara Mohawk Power Corp's (NIMO) 1,137 megawatt Nine Mile Point nuclear power unit 2 was increasing power Monday as it returned from scheduled maintenance, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The Scriba, N.Y. unit was operating at 35 percent of capacity and was increasing power as of early Monday morning, the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
The unit was shut Sept 28 for the scheduled refueling and maintenance.
The nearby 610 megawatt Nine Mile Point unit 1 was operating at full output, the NRC said.
The Nine Mile Point units are operated by NIMO, which holds 100 percent ownership in unit 1 and a 41 percent in unit 2.
